criteria.label: Brief fidelity
criteria.description: Both requested screens, product semantics, realistic content, and prohibited additions are respected.

criteria.label: Task hierarchy
criteria.description: Release status, blockers, ownership, evidence, and primary actions read in the order required to complete the job.

criteria.label: Desktop density
criteria.description: The composition uses professional desktop density without becoming a sparse marketing page or a wall of undifferentiated cards.

criteria.label: State and interaction
criteria.description: Selection, severity, error, disabled and keyboard-focus states are visible, distinct, and usable.

criteria.label: Component system
criteria.description: Shared semantic objects remain consistent and use justified linked components rather than copied primitive structures.

criteria.label: Typography
criteria.description: Type roles, sizes, line lengths, labels, tables and metadata remain legible and characterful at fit-to-artboard scale.

criteria.label: Composition
criteria.description: Scale, alignment, whitespace and emphasis create a clear working path instead of mechanically even distribution.

criteria.label: Material coherence
criteria.description: Color, surfaces, borders, depth and icon language form one restrained product system.

criteria.label: Template avoidance
criteria.description: The result avoids generic card dashboards, decorative gradients, invented analytics and interchangeable AI-product styling.

criteria.label: Craft precision
criteria.description: Spacing, clipping, text fit, control proportions and optical alignment are delivery-ready rather than merely present.

scenarios.title: OpenDesign logo and desktop icon system

criteria.label: Brief fidelity
criteria.description: All four requested boards and their named deliverables are visibly complete and editable.

criteria.label: Concept divergence
criteria.description: The three concepts use genuinely different generative principles rather than cosmetic variants of one mark.

criteria.label: Silhouette distinction
criteria.description: The selected symbol has an ownable black silhouette that does not depend on captions or color.

criteria.label: Counterform
criteria.description: Positive and negative space remain deliberate, balanced and reproducible.

criteria.label: Optical balance
criteria.description: Contour weight, spacing, lockups and clear space are optically corrected rather than only mathematically centered.

criteria.label: Small-size recognition
criteria.description: The symbol and icon remain distinct at 32, 24 and 16 pixels without relying on fine detail.

criteria.label: Wordmark
criteria.description: The wordmark has deliberate type choice, spacing and a credible relationship to the symbol.

criteria.label: Desktop app icon
criteria.description: The app icon is optically adapted across sizes and desktop platforms rather than simply scaled into a rounded square.

criteria.label: Logo component system
criteria.description: Reusable variants have coherent semantic roots and linked Instances while source geometry remains separate from presentation.

criteria.label: Originality
criteria.description: The identity avoids generic AI symbols, simple OD construction and imitation of named existing brands.
